title: bddo:vaxF reads VAX F_floating and D_floating in their own word order
description: 48 42 00 00 is the words 0x4248, 0x0000: sign 0, exponent 132, fraction 0x480000, so (0.5 + 0x480000 / 2^24) x 2^4 = 12.5. The D_floating 80 40 then six zero bytes is the word 0x4080 first: exponent 129, fraction 0, so 0.5 x 2 = 1.0. The struct's little-endian declaration is not consulted.
